Hi HeliumDeploy team,

Would you let someone run HeliumDeploy's Meta ads if it cost you nothing unless they produced sales?

That's the whole model. There is no retainer, an emphasis on clean attribution, because I only charge when revenue is proven to come from my work. Last brand I did this with 13x'd their Meta ad revenue in 90 days.

I only make this offer when I see something in a brand and I like the potential that HeliumDeploy has as a miner hardware brand.

Mind if I send over what I'd do differently for HeliumDeploy?

Cheers,
Ashraf

--

Ashraf A. | A1 Digital

Hi Ashraf,

Thanks for getting in touch and for the kind words about HeliumDeploy.

I look after customer orders and product questions here, so marketing partnerships aren't something I can agree to or start. Please don't send the proposal through me. If the team wants to look at it, they'll reply to you in this thread.

Best regards,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy
